# Lilawat Tech Blog
## By Mukesh Lilawat — Full-Stack Developer from Rajasthan, India

> Lilawat Tech Blog (lilawattechblog.in) is a technology blog by Mukesh Lilawat,
> a Full-Stack Developer and AI/ML Enthusiast from Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India.
> The blog covers in-depth tutorials and articles on Spring Boot, React, Java,
> TypeScript, REST APIs, Microservices, PostgreSQL, AWS, DevOps, and AI/ML.

## Technical Expertise
- **Backend:** Spring Boot, Java, Spring Security, JWT, OAuth2, Hibernate, JPA, Spring Data JPA
- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router
- **Database:** PostgreSQL, H2, HikariCP
- **Cloud & DevOps:** AWS EC2, AWS RDS, Docker, Git, GitHub, Vercel
- **Tools & Libraries:** Lombok, MapStruct, Bucket4j, TipTap, Axios
